message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is the protoplanet **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 × Jupiter’s radius** (about 18,000 km).  Because it is still forming, its exact size and mass are still being refined, but it remains the biggest planet we know of in the observable universe.
